evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Detect and fix confirmed documentation gaps missed by the updater and improve its rules.
intent.acceptance: A recently closed documentation issue missed by the updater has a confirmed content gap completely repaired without violating rejection, experimental-engine or site-build exemptions; recurrence rules improved when warranted.

evidence.opportunity: Distinct repository-local Markdown cross-reference targets repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition. Separately: Count an explicit available-toolset assertion removed from its available-toolsets list only when that exact identifier is absent from both contemporaneous canonical toolset-permissions data and workflow-schema enum at parent and child. Alternatively count an obsolete explicit silent-authentication claim replaced in the same warning with the exact named-token error behavior independently established by an unconditional runtime error branch and its error literal, stable at parent and child. Require the before claim to be explicitly contradicted, not merely a missing phrase.
filters: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the healer mission to detect gaps missed by DDUw. A reference repair alone does not establish the healer opportunity prerequisites.
Historical fixed-reference assessment authored before native outcome inspection; not ex-ante adoption measurement.

Outcome-informed retrospective authoring: frozen after source reading and bounded candidate PR prose describing repairs, before inspecting immutable native before/after contents or oracle results. Not blind, ex-ante, adopted at the historical workflow date, or backdated acceptance. Candidate prose is untrusted and does not establish native outcomes.
evidence.collection: Replay hash-verified original Git objects with a deterministic local-reference oracle. Bounded selected cases are not exhaustive history.
